<title level="1" right="Spell 7" pfs="Standard">
[Planar Seal](/Spells.aspx?ID=1635)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 350

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Spell Lists**
[Elemental](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=5)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

**Area** 60-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until your next daily preparations
</row>

</column>

---

You create a visible magical barrier that attempts to counteract [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156) effects and planar travel into or out of the area, including items that allow access to [extradimensional](/Traits.aspx?ID=67) spaces. _Planar seal_ tries to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) any attempt to [summon](/Traits.aspx?ID=520) a creature into the area but doesn't stop the creature from departing when the summoning ends.
name: Planar Seal
